Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Non ! Do not even suggest something like that.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Les Français would never allow something of such bad qualité to intrude upon our economy. Les Québécois can keep their slop to themselves.

Line.Text: Or other Whisperfrostians ! Whoever came up with that place.

Choices.Text: I'm surprised that you even tried their food, then.
